flags.title: 'Tie' printed as the most-tipped Money Line selection on 11 of 15 matches
flags.detail: OLBG's Handball listing prints the literal string 'Tie' as the most-tipped Money Line selection on eleven of the fifteen listed events, including SC Magdeburg v HC Kriens-Luzern at 9 of 14, where the official EHF Champions League group F table has Magdeburg 5-0-0 with +36 and Kriens-Luzern 2-0-3 with -3. A draw is a legal group-phase result - the official tables record two draws across the thirty group-phase games played in groups A, C and F - but it cannot be backed on a money line, so the selection is unusable as a match-winner tip.
flags.board_effect: All fifteen handball rows are priced from the official EHF group tables instead. Six rows are left blank: HC Vardar v MT Melsungen, Wisla Plock v Nantes, RK Celje v RK Zagreb, GOG v Sporting CP, Montpellier v Dinamo Bucuresti and IFK Kristianstad v Pick Szeged, none of which appear in the official Champions League group tables.
